tool_input.description: Compile and run probe program against DurationFormatUtils

result:
All green, confirming it's the only `*AgentTest.java` file and nothing else is affected.

Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/DurationFormatUtilsAgentTest.java` (35 self-contained JUnit 5 tests, Java 8 syntax, no lambdas/diamond operators). It covers:
- `formatDuration`/`formatDurationHMS`/`formatDurationISO` happy paths, zero, `Long.MAX_VALUE`, negative-input `IllegalArgumentException`, padding-width/count edge cases, and folding of unrequested larger fields into a smaller token.
- `formatDurationWords` suppression logic (leading-only, trailing-only, both, neither), pluralization, and the middle-zero-field-not-suppressed edge case.
- `formatPeriod`/`formatPeriodISO`, including folding when `y`/`M`/`H`/`m`/`s` tokens are omitted, same start==end instant, and start>end throwing.
- Package-private `lexx`, `Token`, and `format` internals: tokenizing, merging repeated chars, literal/default branch, empty pattern, all four `lexx` exception cases (nested optional, unopened bracket, unmatched quote, unmatched optional), `Token.equals`/`hashCode`/`toString`/`containsTokenWithValue`, and all five optional-block examples from the class javadoc table.

All test values were verified against the actual implementation via a temporary scratch probe (compiled against `target/classes`, then deleted) rather than guessed, so expectations reflect real behavior, not assumptions.
